question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the word: **Debacle**
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. Success .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **Debacle** means a sudden and ignominious failure or a complete collapse.
 
• To find an antonym, we need a word that has the opposite meaning, i.e., something that conveys success or triumph.
 
• Among the given options:
 
 
• **Disaster** (Option 1): Synonymous with debacle, meaning a catastrophic failure.
 
• **Success** (Option 2): Opposite of debacle, meaning achievement or victory.
 
• **Failure** (Option 3): Synonymous with debacle, meaning lack of success.
 
• **Collapse** (Option 4): Synonymous with debacle, meaning breakdown or failure.
 
 

Correct sentence: The most appropriate antonym of the word **Debacle** is **Success**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Synonyms of Debacle:**
 
 
• Disaster
 
• Collapse
 
• Failure
 
 
 
• **Antonyms of Debacle:**
 
 
• Success
 
• Triumph
 
• Achievement
